WITH s1 AS (
  SELECT s.telescref AS t, o.weathprofile AS w, AVG(s.modindex) AS m, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS p
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes te ON te.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = te.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.modindex) AS m
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes te ON te.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = te.observstation
),
s3 AS (
  SELECT s1.t, s1.w, s1.m AS m, s1.p AS p, s1.m - s2.m AS d
  FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL
  WHERE s1.m > s2.m
)
SELECT w, AVG(m), AVG(p), AVG(d)
FROM s3
GROUP BY w
